inventory_method: Parse only WHO index listing metadata and official WHO item-page links; do not request any linked national document or Download target.
boundary: The listed item pages and metadata locate candidate national/regional resources only. WHO describes a collection gathered from heterogeneous upstream sources; no rights conclusion, source-document acquisition, medicine coverage, or qualification is inferred.
items_digest_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON serialization of the items array using ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'); this is not the inventory file digest.
